replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. First, standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix. Next, calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. Sort the eigenvalues in descending order and select the top k eigenvalues. The corresponding eigenvectors form the principal components. Project the data onto the new feature space formed by the selected principal components. The mathematics behind PCA can be complex, but you don't need to be anxious. With practice and the right resources, you can understand it.
